facts.statement: Every price below is a planning figure from the Golden Maple cost estimator, before HST, mid-tier materials, an accessible site. Final prices are confirmed at a site visit.
Most interlocking patios of 300–1,000 sq ft come out around $40–$45 per square foot before HST, typically $38–$64 depending on access, shape and finishes.
Smaller patios cost more per square foot: about $53 at 200 sq ft.
Premium paver lines add about $5 per square foot.
A 300 sq ft interlocking patio is most likely about $13,500 before HST (planning band $12,000–$19,500).
A 400 sq ft interlocking patio is most likely about $16,500 before HST (planning band $15,500–$22,500).
A 600 sq ft interlocking patio is most likely about $24,000 before HST (planning band $23,000–$32,000).
A 1,000 sq ft interlocking patio is most likely about $40,000 before HST (planning band $37,500–$51,000).
A 100–200 sq ft paver walkway runs around $53–$82 per square foot before HST (shorter walkways cost more per foot); a 200 sq ft walkway is most likely about $10,500.
Retaining walls run around $330–$670 per linear foot before HST for walls from under 2 ft up to 4–6 ft high (about 50 ft of wall).
A retaining wall under 2 ft high is around $330 per linear foot (typically $280–$425) for about 50 ft of wall.
A retaining wall 2–4 ft high is around $470 per linear foot (typically $405–$555) for about 50 ft of wall.
A retaining wall 4–6 ft high is around $670 per linear foot (typically $585–$770) for about 50 ft of wall.
A retaining wall 6 ft+ high is around $970 per linear foot (typically $845–$1,090) for about 50 ft of wall.
Decks are priced only in the 3D deck designer at /deck-designer. Never quote a deck price per square foot.

Anything not listed here (driveways, porcelain, natural stone, pergolas, kitchens, fire pits, drainage, lighting, sod, permits, repairs) has NO published price: say it is confirmed at a site visit and link the cost estimator.
